sentences.text: On June 1, 2026, Nu appointed Rob Livingston, previously Visa's CFO for North America, as chief financial officer effective July 13, succeeding Guilherme Lago, who moved to Special Advisor after five years as CFO and seven years at Nu, supporting the transition through August 31 and advising management and the Audit and Risk Committee.
The company stated the planned transition does not change its operating model, risk appetite or long-term strategy, while a dedicated Brazil CFO role is being created.

sentences.quote: CEO David Velez said Livingston brings deep knowledge of global financial institutions and a clear view of the US, where Nubank has already received conditional approval for a bank and where Livingston will be based.
sentences.text: Velez cited Livingston's US knowledge as Nu pursues its conditionally approved US bank, with Livingston based there and overseeing country CFOs.

citations.title: Nu Holdings Ltd. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

sentences.text: Under founder, chairman and CEO David Velez, Nu Holdings has executed its multi-product, multi-country strategy consistently: Q2 2026 brought 138.9 million customers, revenue up 39% year over year to $5.88 billion, and record net income of $1.06 billion with a 33% ROE, while Mexico reached break-even in Q1 2026 after becoming the country's third largest financial institution.

sentences.quote: Efficiency Ratio increased to 19.5% in Q2'26 from 17.6% in Q1'26 (21.3% in Q2'25)
sentences.text: Cost discipline is visible in a 19.5% efficiency ratio, though 90-plus-day NPLs rose to 6.9%.
On governance, the CEO also chairs the board, a concentration of roles; notably, he unilaterally terminated his 2021 Contingent Share Award, with no shares issued under it.
